name: Happy Path — Book Spouse Only Appointment (All Valid Inputs)
goal: User successfully books an annual health checkup appointment for spouse only, providing all valid details in the first attempt.
constraints: All user inputs are valid and accepted by the system on first try. User chooses 'Only Spouse' at coverage step.

result.message: You are eligible to book an appointment.

phases.description: Bot presents booking option based on eligibility; user chooses to book.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays eligibility message and quick reply for booking; user selects 'Book an appointment'.

phases.description: Bot asks for coverage type; user selects 'Only Spouse'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot renders Coverage Type widget; user selection is stored as 'Only Spouse'.

phases.description: Bot collects spouse name and DOB; user provides valid name and valid DOB (age > 18, past date).
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts spouse name and DOB, stores them, and proceeds.

phases.description: Bot asks for appointment date; user provides valid date.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts date, stores it as appointmentDatestr.

phases.description: Bot validates appointment date via workflow; receives valid response.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot receives isValid=true and formatted date.

phases.description: Bot collects and validates 10-digit mobile number.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts and stores valid mobile number.

phases.description: Bot collects and validates state and city.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts valid state and city.

phases.description: Bot renders clinic selection widget; user selects a clinic.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms clinic selection, thanks user, displays clinic name, and confirms booking.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
